rulings_errata.name: [Errata IAR] Levia Textbox update
rulings_errata.description:
This card's textbox was updated to "If a card with 6 or more {p} has been put into your banished zone this turn, you don't lose {h} from blood debt during the end phase."
This change lets cards with 6 or more {p} banished during the beginning of end phase to interact with blood debt triggers that are already on the stack.
